skill.summary: A self-evolution engine for AI agents. Analyzes runtime history to identify improvements and applies protocol-constrained evolution.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of capability-evolver: a self-evolution engine for AI agents.

- Enables autonomous analysis of runtime history and self-improvement through protocol-constrained evolution.
- Features auto-log analysis, self-repair on detected errors, and one-command evolution workflow.
- Supports flexible evolution strategies and allows both automated and human-in-the-loop review modes.
- Integrates with EvoMap network for node registration, memory, and asset syncing.
- Includes fine-grained environment variable configuration and permissions for network, shell, and local file access.
